question: What decision currently governs Python package metadata? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-345 (Metadata for Python Software Packages 1.2) is the currently active decision governing Python package metadata.
The authority evidence for PEP-345 is hosted at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/a0d411a7e334ddede263fdf9862f06bfc035f21c/pep-0345.txt.
